background_rationale: A certified public accountant (inactive) with 48 years of energy-industry finance and accounting experience, he served two long stints as Enterprise's CFO before becoming co-CEO.

notable.summary: Became co-CEO alongside A.J. 'Jim' Teague while keeping the CFO post, with responsibility for finance, accounting, IT and risk management while Teague oversaw commercial, operations and engineering.
Handed the CFO title to R. Daniel Boss effective March 1, 2024, while continuing as co-CEO and supervising the finance, treasury and tax leaders.
Enterprise announced that Teague will retire on Jan. 4, 2027, and that Fowler will then become sole CEO, with the Office of the Chairman expanded to include the chief commercial officer and CFO.

personal_story.hook: Randy Fowler joined Enterprise as director of investor relations in 1999; in January 2027 he is set to become sole CEO.
personal_story.summary: Little about Fowler's early life is public. A certified public accountant (now inactive), he had already worked in energy-industry finance and accounting before joining Enterprise in January 1999, shortly after its IPO, as director of investor relations. He rose through treasurer and CFO roles, also running Enterprise's privately held affiliate EPCO as president and CEO from 2007 to 2010, and served as Enterprise's CFO from 2007 to 2015 and again from 2018 to 2024. He became co-CEO with Jim Teague in January 2020 and is slated to become sole CEO when Teague retires on Jan. 4, 2027.
